hero.title: Biotechnology
hero.subtitle: Germany is Europe's life sciences and pharmaceutical innovation leader, offering globally accredited Bachelor's, Master's, and PhD programmes in Biotechnology, Molecular Biology, and Bioengineering with tuition-free public university options and an 18-month post-study work visa.

overview: Germany is a premier destination for biotechnology studies due to its world-class research infrastructure, state-of-the-art laboratory facilities, and strong collaboration between universities and leading biotech corporations across genetic engineering, molecular biology, and bioprocessing.
Edu-Hawk Worldwide Consultancy guides Indian students through university selection, English and German-taught biotechnology pathways, mandatory APS verification, and student visa processing.

seo.title: Biotechnology in Germany for Indian Students | Edu-Hawk Worldwide
seo.description: Complete guide to studying Biotechnology in Germany: B.Sc., M.Sc. & PhD programmes, top German universities (TUM, TU Dresden, Heidelberg, Stuttgart), tuition-free education, and 18-month post-study work visa.
